subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next Friday at the local park. This is a great opportunity for us to bond outside of the office and engage in fun activities together. Please RSVP by the end of the week so we can finalize the arrangements. Don't forget to bring comfortable clothing and a positive attitude! We look forward to seeing you all there. Best regards, [Sender]
